description: Every review finding, nits and surviving mutants included, must go to the resolver and end applied or rejected with a written reason, and approval needs exactly three reviewer verdicts. Nothing in Stage 4 checks either: a finding with no recorded outcome, or a consensus formed from fewer or more than three verdicts, can still reach approval.
goal: Add a Stage 4 gate that blocks consensus approval while any finding from the iteration's merged reviewer findings lacks a recorded resolver disposition (applied with a commit, or rejected with a non-empty reason), and while the number of returned reviewer verdicts is not exactly three. Put the check in one new module with pure functions over the findings, the dispositions and the verdicts, and call it from the existing consensus decision path. A blocked approval reports the finding ids or the verdict count in its blockers. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Review is the final automated gate; a finding waved through or an approval on a short ensemble defeats it, and a hard gate means no agent has to remember it.
acceptance_criteria: review_finding_outcomes.py returns the ids of findings with no disposition, or a rejected one with an empty reason, and flags a verdict count other than three; test_review_finding_outcomes.py proves it fails on a fake review loop that leaves a nit and a surviving mutant without an outcome, and passes when every finding is applied or rejected with a reason.

flow/review/verdict.py adds the unresolved finding ids and the wrong verdict count to the consensus blockers so an APPROVED verdict becomes CHANGES_REQUESTED; tests in tests/flow/review/test_consensus_integrity.py prove it for two verdicts, four verdicts and one unresolved finding, and that a complete three-verdict approval still passes.
flow/review/approval_gates.py records no approved diff gate for a blocked consensus; tests/flow/review/test_approval_gates.py covers it.

flow/review/loop.py passes the iteration's merged findings and recorded dispositions to the gate, and tests/flow/review/test_loop.py proves a loop iteration with an undisposed finding cannot end in approval.

No docstrings and no comments except '# why:' in anything added; every new module is at most 200 lines; holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged; 'uv run pytest' on the new and touched tests, 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass. The new module sits directly in the sandbox_executor package, not under flow/, so no package re-export file is edited.
